plugins.name: notrest
plugins.description: A session harness by Not Rest Inc. — the scaffolding a working Claude session runs inside, not a pile of skills. Discipline is auto-anchored into every session by the SessionStart hook: a verification-first contract (probe before believing, prove at the consumer, label the unverified, bank before stopping). Delegation is an arrangement rather than an afterthought — agentswarm keeps the seat on decompose/judge/gate and puts the work on explicit-Opus lanes, receipted by an append-only spend ledger that makes the model-routing policy checkable instead of merely asserted. The estate writes itself: COORD.md records what every prompt landed and COORD-AGENTS.md auto-indexes every agent that finishes, so the trail survives compaction, crashes and model changes. Continuity carries across sessions — handoff files, a live line back to the predecessor session, and a successor escort window. And the harness grades itself: a shipped eval suite runs the rules against real sessions. Riding on it, thirty natural-language-invocable skills from intake to handoff: ORACLE intake with skill routing, researcher / marketresearcher / explainer / decider / factcheck / watch / introspect / game-forge / gpt / chatroom / archivist / spend / compile / draft / doctor / eval / refuter / recap / graph / stepbystep / actionplan / critic / beam, a director that chains skills into pipelines, a fable-director that runs the '3 devs and a relay' multi-session arrangement, an agentswarm that runs the fast same-machine delegation arrangement (any seat — Fable or Opus — plus concurrent in-session Opus lanes), a self-recording sessionend handoff with a live cross-session line, and fable-mode — the full discipline contract, loadable on demand. Real tiered sources, honesty labels, search budgets, self-checks, --quick modes throughout.
